fullPassage: The violin had always been Ann's thing since she was seven. Her teacher Mrs. Jones always said she had natural talent. But lately, every time Ann picked up her bow, she couldn't focus. She kept thinking about Victoria Gray, the brilliant violinist who had performed at Maestro Hall. Before the lesson with Mrs. Jones, Ann was watching Victoria's flawless technique on her smartphone, and it made her chest feel tighter. What was the point? Ann thought. I'll never be like her. As the lesson began, her teacher, Mrs. Jones, immediately noticed Ann's distraction. "Is everything alright, Ann?" asked Mrs. Jones. "I'm just wondering if I'm good enough to be special like Victoria," Ann said. "I used to love playing. Now I just feel like I'm not good enough. I don't have the perfect technique like her." Hearing her words, Mrs. Jones smiled softly and said, "That's because you're measuring yourself against someone else's ruler. Comparison steals your joy and unique voice. Stop looking at her journey and focus on your own." Hearing those comforting words, something profound shifted inside Ann. After the lesson, Ann took down Victoria Gray's picture that had always been on her bedroom wall. That night, Ann deleted her social media app from her smartphone. She focused on practicing her violin, trying to find herself, for a week. On Saturday, Ann picked up her violin and played a simple piece she'd known since childhood. Her music had mistakes, but it felt like her own music again. When she finished, her little sister Emma clapped enthusiastically. "When you play, it makes the whole house feel nicer." Ann smiled, finally at peace.

① your own talent(너 자신의 재능): 비교를 비판하는 맥락과 안 맞아요.
② the school's standard(학교의 기준): 본문에 근거가 없어요.
③ someone else's ruler(남의 잣대): 'measuring yourself against ___. Comparison steals your joy(비교가 기쁨을 앗아간다)'로 이어지므로, 자신을 '남의 잣대'로 잰다는 비유가 알맞아요. ←정답
④ your teacher's advice(선생님의 조언): 비교 비유와 맞지 않아요.
det.tip: measuring yourself against someone else's ruler = 남의 잣대로 자신을 재다

questions.passage: The violin had always been Ann's thing since she was seven. Her teacher Mrs. Jones always said she had natural talent. But lately, every time Ann picked up her bow, she couldn't focus. She kept thinking about Victoria Gray, the brilliant violinist who had performed at Maestro Hall. Before the lesson with Mrs. Jones, Ann was watching Victoria's flawless technique on her smartphone, and it made her chest feel tighter. What was the point? Ann thought. I'll never be like her. As the lesson began, her teacher, Mrs. Jones, immediately noticed Ann's distraction. "Is everything alright, Ann?" asked Mrs. Jones. "I'm just wondering if I'm good enough to be special like Victoria," Ann said. "I used to love playing. Now I just feel like I'm not good enough. I don't have the perfect technique like her." Hearing her words, Mrs. Jones smiled softly and said, "That's because you're measuring yourself against someone else's ruler. Comparison steals your joy and unique voice. Stop looking at her journey and focus on your own." Hearing those comforting words, something profound shifted inside Ann. After the lesson, Ann took down Victoria Gray's picture that had always been on her bedroom wall. That night, Ann deleted her social media app from her smartphone. She focused on practicing her violin, trying to find herself, for a week. On Saturday, Ann picked up her violin and played a simple piece she'd known since childhood. Her music had mistakes, but it felt like her own music again. When she finished, her little sister Emma clapped enthusiastically. "When you play, it makes the whole house feel nicer." Ann smiled, finally at peace.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ① Ann이 레슨 전 스마트폰으로 Victoria의 기교를 보고 있었다 (일치)
det.analysis:
✅ ① 일치: 'Before the lesson ... Ann was watching Victoria's flawless technique on her smartphone(레슨 전 스마트폰으로 Victoria의 기교를 보고 있었다)'와 맞아요. ←정답
❌ ② 불일치: Mrs. Jones는 비교를 멈추고 자신에게 집중하라고 했어요.
❌ ③ 불일치: Ann은 소셜 미디어 앱을 '삭제'했어요.
❌ ④ 불일치: Emma는 열정적으로 박수 치며 집이 더 좋아진다고 했어요.
det.tip: watching Victoria's technique on her smartphone
